system.description:
You are trained in the K'tara style of Unarmed fighting, which enables you to neutralize enemies before they even know that you are present.

Prerequisites: Martial Arts I, Trained in Stealth

Effect: You roll an extra die of damage against a Flat-Footed enemy on one Unarmed Attack during your turn.

Once per encounter, when you deal damage with an Unarmed Attack to a target that has been denied its Dexterity bonus to Reflex Defense, make a second Unarmed attack against the target's Fortitude Defense as a Free Action. If successful, you render the target incapable of speech until the end of your next turn. This is a Stunning effect.

Special: If you have the K'tara Expertise Talent, you can spend two Swift Actions to cause a single adjacent enemy to be Flat-Footed against your first attack during the same round.
